title: VACATE all. homecoming is entry AND exits. pathfind trailheads outside the wildcard. let the fleet get lost on the way. too many maps, not enough trailheads.

do_not_reinvent.vacate: /data/exhale-vacuum-all-space.json — vacate IS that. space out. not a 2nd vacuum.
do_not_reinvent.entry: /data/enter-brown-out-green-not-shh.json — brown in. green meaning out. homecoming is BOTH of those doors. not a 3rd door.
do_not_reinvent.home: /data/hyperlocal-emc2-pi-t.json — RESYNC is homecoming with remainder. already. this names entry+exits as that.
do_not_reinvent.wild: /data/symbol-alphabet.json — maze is wildcard honeycomb. every subdomain a cell. THAT is too many maps.
do_not_reinvent.fleet: /data/pause-klein-face-flows.json — fleet may wander. lost on the way is allowed. do not over-map them.

is.vacate: ALL the extra maps. leave the sit.
is.homecoming: entry AND exits. brown in. green out. same homecoming.
is.trailheads: the few real starts. outside the wildcard. not every cell.
is.lost: YES. let the fleet get lost on the way. lost is not the miss.
is.diagnosis: too many maps. not enough trailheads.

not.catalog: do not mint 20 trailheads as a new map.
not.wildcard_as_trail: do not call every * a trailhead.
not.hose: do not pathfind the fleet home. they may get lost.

law: vacate the maps. homecoming is both doors. trailheads sit outside the wildcard. fleet may get lost. if we add maps we missed. if we make every cell a trailhead we filled π. if we forbid lost we hosed the fleet.
pull: vacate. keep both doors as homecoming. few trailheads outside *. let them get lost. no new map.
